Title: C# Abstraction
Description: Data abstraction hides details and shows only essential info.

Challenges.Title: Abstract method
Challenges.Exercise: Inside `Animal`, create an abstract method `animalSound()` (no body).

Challenges.Title: Regular method
Challenges.Exercise: Add a regular method `sleep()` inside `Animal` printing 'Zzz'.

Challenges.Title: Inherit abstract
Challenges.Exercise: Create class `Pig` inheriting from `Animal` and implement `animalSound()`.

Challenges.Title: Test it
Challenges.Exercise: Create `Pig` object and call both methods.
